vet-shortlist.description: Human-readable shortlist of x402 services worth calling: 575 traction-rated services ranked by volume net of the largest buyer, plus ~42,000 facilitator-listed endpoints on request

category.description: Directory category to filter by, e.g. AI. Omit for all categories

network.description: Settlement network the service must support, e.g. base

maxPriceUsd.description: Highest acceptable minimum price per call, in USD

minBuyers.description: Fewest distinct 30-day buyers to accept. Default 2

minNetVolume30d.description: Lowest acceptable 30-day volume net of the largest buyer, in USD. Default 10

minUsdPerBuyer.description: Lowest acceptable revenue per buyer, in USD. Default 0.1

includeThin.description: Include services whose demand is one relationship or too small to read. Default false

limit.description: Most results to return, 1 to 100. Default 20

probe.description: Run the unpaid 402 handshake against the top 50 results, aimed at each seller's published paid path. Rated rows may require one detail request plus the probe. Default false

includeUnrated.description: Also return endpoints from the facilitator catalogs that have prices and receivers but no measured demand at all. Default false

output.description: Human-readable Markdown shortlist with verdicts, prices, networks, live payment checks, evidence, coverage, freshness and attribution

vet-service.description: Human-readable review of one x402 endpoint before paying it: traction directory first, then ~42,000 facilitator-listed endpoints, always with a live 402 handshake

slug.description: Directory slug of the service to vet

url.description: Public HTTPS resource URL of the endpoint to vet. Resolves against the facilitator catalogs when the traction directory has never heard of it

output.description: Human-readable Markdown review with a recommendation, price, network, live payment check, recipient comparison, evidence, freshness and attribution
